title: BornToday
tagline: A NFT  lootbox  to celebrate when your baby is born. BornToday!
description: A NFT lootbox to celebrate when your baby is born. If possible to a gitf from friends and also send something to all my friends. All of them will be able to get one NFT celebrating the day. The collection of NTF are ideal for little baby girls and boys whether it is to welcome them into the world, and mark a milestone in their life with their arrival.
how_its_made: I will be using polygon and also thirdweb SDK so it will be easy to generate a NFT gifts for them. The  build of a simple web app that celebrate when your baby is born with a lootbox. They'll be able to open that lootbox to reveal one of our NFTs at random. Also page where users can see the NFTs they’ve given and restrict that page to only holders of our NFTs.
